steps.26: iATU outbound region 0 = CFG0 -> bus 1 (7 DBI-window writes at ATU 0x14B00000, each read back, CR2 re-checked once) and 4 reads of the CFG window 0x60FFE000 (explicit --wlan-link=26 only; ATU torn down FIRST)
steps.27: READ-ONLY dump of the endpoint config space (56 dwords of bus 1 dev 0 fn 0 through the CFG window left enabled by S26) + the iATU outbound region 1 reset values (7 reads); 0x8C-0xA8 deliberately not read (0xA4 PCI_BACKPLANE_DATA is a backplane access, 0x90/0x98 interrupt/mailbox), 0xAC kept; explicit --wlan-link=27 only; no write
steps.28: BAR0/BAR2 sizing (all-ones write, guarded read-back, original written back; Linux __pci_read_base order) then assignment BAR0 0x60000000 / BAR2 0x60400000 through the CFG window (research 33; the FIRST config writes, Command never touched; explicit --wlan-link=28 only; BAR teardown FIRST, before the ATU disable)
steps.29: iATU outbound region 1 = MEM (CPU 0x60000000..0x6000FFFF -> PCI 0x60000000, BAR0 only; 4 ATU writes, CR2 last), BAR0 window cfg 0x80 := 0x18000000, then Command := MEM only (research 36; the first Command write, MASTER never; explicit --wlan-link=29 only; region 1 disable, Command 0 and the window restore FIRST in the teardown)
steps.30: the FIRST BAR0 read: ChipCommon chipid at MEM 0x60000000 (research 36; one guarded read + logged copy + link/AER logs + one-shot id == 0x4389; explicit --wlan-link=30 only; no write; a bus stall would show as the last line `LINK S30 start`)
steps.31: READ-ONLY on the chip (research 37 s.9.1 run A): ChipCommon eromptr (CC+0xFC), clk_ctl_st (CC+0x1E0) and capabilities_ext (CC+0xAC) through the BAR0 window left at 0x18000000 by S29 (3 logged MEM reads + link/AER logs + one-shot checks: window still 0x18000000, eromptr 4 KiB aligned inside 0x18000000..0x1FFFFFFF, chip id still 0x4389; explicit --wlan-link=31 only; no write of any kind, no window move)
steps.5: PHY isolation release (EL3 RMW, audited helper)
steps.6: clocks: none in the clock framework

unknown.what: dw_pcie_setup_rc() (generic DWC host code, rc.c:3216) and the DBI writes of exynos_pcie_setup_rc() (rc.c:2720-2790)
unknown.why: SOURCE NOW READ (dwc-generic, android14-6.1) but S22 stays UNKNOWN (and is SKIPPED, see its delay row): it needs runtime values. (1) dw_pcie_msi_init() (pcie-designware-host.c:273-284, called at :740) writes DBI 0x820/0x824 (PCIE_MSI_ADDR_LO/HI, rc.h:206-207) with pp->msi_data, a dmam_alloc_coherent() DMA address (pcie-designware-host.c:383-391); it runs because pci_msi_enabled() is true by default, no msi_host_init/msi-parent/msi-map exists (rc.c:2805-2807, dts), so has_msi_ctrl is true (:462); a non-constant, and the Exynos driver rewrites it itself (rc.c:2982-2983). (2) dw_pcie_setup() -> dw_pcie_link_set_max_speed() (pcie-designware.c:489-521, link_gen = DT max-link-speed GEN2 from common.dtsi:373 via :449) addresses LNKCAP/LNKCTL2 at dw_pcie_find_capability(PCI_CAP_ID_EXP)+off, a DBI cap-list walk (:73-82) whose result is read, not constant (expected 0x70 = PCIE_CAP_OFFSET, rc.h:124: a guess until measured). (3) the numeric LINK_SPEED_GEN2 (dt-bindings) and PCI_VENDOR_ID_SAMSUNG (linux pci_ids.h) defines are not in the fetched refs. (4) every Linux DBI access on this path is bracketed by clock enable + PCS rx-elecidle ignore/enable (rd_own_conf rc.c:1269-1312, wr_own_conf rc.c:1314-1356), i.e. extra PCS writes the shim would have to replay. Resolved for later (read from source): iATU skipped (child_ops = exynos ops, rc.c:2800, vs pcie-designware-host.c:770); N_FTS and cdm-check skipped (not set / not in dts); num-lanes=1 (common.dtsi:368) gives PCIE_PORT_LINK_CONTROL(0x710) RMW and 0x80C width=1; dbi_ro_wr_en/dis = RMW of 0x8BC bit0 (pcie-designware.h:390-410); exynos_pcie_rc_wr/rd_own_conf = rc_dbi_base + where, refused while phy_control == PCIE_PHY_ISOLATION (rd :1278, wr :1323-1324). Details: docs/research/29 section 14, S22 row.
